headline: REST: race done. 2h14 on the Wine Trail Half, today stays a full rest day
summary: Race graded: Chiuro to Sondrio, 22.1km, 825m D+ in 134min (about 6:04/km). Sub-2h00 missed by about 14min. Avg HR 172, max 187, load 212 vs 180 planned. RPE 9, feel 3 (Normal). Averaging 172bpm for 2h14 puts the whole race at the top of the 163-172 climb band, so you raced on effort and did not hold back. The gap to 2h00 was not pacing restraint. It looks more like the course, or the specific fitness for 900m D+ at that speed. Start line: CTL 53.7 / ATL 47.2 on Fri 6 (TSB +6.5). That was fresher than the +2 to +5 target and 1.3 under the CTL 55 target. Taper slightly over-rested. This morning: HRV 61 (69 yesterday, -8), RHR 51, sleep 7.2h (score 68). That is technically green, but it is the day after a 212-load race and the plan has rest. CTL 56.1, ATL 60.0. No running today. A 20-30min walk before the 21:25 Barcelona flight is fine. Eat and drink well, carbs plus protein at every meal.
flags: Plan ends today (week 8). Nothing is scheduled from Mon 9 Nov: the next block needs repointing in the coaching chat before the daily coach can prescribe.
Until then: Mon 9-Wed 11 in Barcelona = rest or 20-30min Z1 walk/jog at or under 141bpm, only if RHR is back at or below 49 and nothing hurts. No intensity before Thu 12.
RHR 51 sits at the green limit and sleep score is 68 despite 7.2h. Expect another 1-2 days of suppressed readiness, especially after a late flight tonight.
Race HR 172 avg for 134min with 825m D+ (course spec 914m): worth reviewing the splits for climb vs descent time when you plan the next block.
